text: Cova is an AI interior design app where you photograph your real room, take a style quiz, and get back a photorealistic redesign of that exact space — walls, windows, and all — plus a shoppable shelf of real products matched to the render. The style quiz builds a Bayesian "fingerprint" across ten design archetypes, which drives a custom LoRA stack for the render so every result is actually personalized to your taste. You're currently mid-rebuild on the end-to-end pipeline — auth and legal are hardened, the render brain is solid, and Phase 2 wiring the quiz into capture is up next.
